# Powsmart

> > Powsmart is a China-based OEM/ODM manufacturer specializing in electric toothbrushes, water flossers, and teeth whitening products with private-label customization for US and international markets.

Powsmart Technology Co., Ltd is headquartered in Shenzhen, China and manufactures a comprehensive range of oral care products including sonic toothbrushes with advanced maglev motor technology, LED whitening devices, water flossers with UVC sterilization, and replacement accessories. The company serves B2B customers seeking customizable, private-label solutions.

## Key Topics

- Electric toothbrush manufacturer
- OEM/ODM supplier
- Sonic toothbrush
- Maglev motor technology
- LED whitening devices
- Private-label customization
- Water flosser
- UVC sterilization
- Wireless charging
- Adult and kids toothbrushes
- Replacement brush heads
- Teeth whitening gel
- China manufacturer
- Shenzhen-based
- USB-C charging
